# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile portrait virtual pet simulator in a single browser `index.html`. Preserve a three-stat needs loop where COZY/HAPPY, SNACK/HUNGER, and GLOW/ENERGY decay over time; care buttons alter stats and pet states; tapping the pet triggers affection; score increments every five seconds survived; and game over appears when food or happiness reaches zero. Present the game as Pika-Plush Garden Pet Simulator: a cozy satirical Zelda-inspired fairy garden with a yellow electric plush mascot, moonlit ruins, sprouts, fireflies, plushie particles, meme aura, gentle anti-anxiety failure language, readable Bangers/Exo typography, and one-thumb mobile controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first virtual pet care simulator.
- objective: keep the companion comfortable by using care actions before core needs decay too far.
- input model: one-thumb tap/click buttons for care actions plus direct pet tap for affection.
- core loop: start session, watch COZY/SNACK/GLOW bars decay, trigger care actions that alter stats and pet animation states, earn one session point every five seconds survived, restart after failure.
- fail/friction state: game over when hunger/snack or happy/cozy reaches zero; some actions are blocked when the pet is full or too low on energy.

## Protected mechanics
- Three-stat virtual pet needs loop: happy/cozy, hunger/snack, and energy/glow.
- Fixed action semantics from the preserved source: feed, treat, water, play, laser/fairy-dot, box/garden, clean, pet, brush, nap, party/meme, selfie.
- Stat decay timing based on a 2.5 base decay rate, score increments every five seconds, and failure on hunger or happiness depletion.
- Pet tap hit-test triggers the PET action; care buttons use native click/tap behavior.
- Visual state changes, particles, floating messages, audio feedback, and restart flow remain feedback-only and do not add new rules.

## Remixed target
Pika-Plush Garden Pet Simulator is a satirical cozy fairy-garden companion game with a yellow electric plush guardian as the focal actor. Zelda-like moonlit ruins, sprouts, fireflies, plushie forms, meme aura moments, and anti-anxiety copy reinterpret the same pet-care loop without changing its mechanics.
